evals.prompt: Slugify this title: "Top 10 Tips for Beginners"
expectations: Numbers are kept as-is, not dropped or altered
Whitespace is converted to single hyphens

evals.prompt: Slugify this title: "What is DevOps? A Guide!"
expectations: Punctuation (? and !) is dropped, not replaced with a hyphen
No double hyphen appears where punctuation was removed
Leading and trailing whitespace/hyphens are trimmed from the result
Consecutive hyphens (from multiple spaces or existing double hyphens) are collapsed into one
Apostrophes are dropped, not replaced with a hyphen
No leading or trailing hyphen remains after the apostrophe removal
The accented character (é) is transliterated to a plain 'e', not silently dropped
The em dash (—) is dropped without leaving a double hyphen in the output
